content.execution_summary:
• Extracted 2 FRs (explicitly tagged) and 1 NFR-relevant statement (untagged, no measurable target) from Requirements.md.
• FR-01 fully designed: Support Logging Service + Support Ticketing API integration + Log Store, all cited to FR-01's own text.
• FR-02 (push notifications) excluded — no integration or dependency detail anywhere in the document for how it would be delivered; not guessed.
• NFR-01 (performance) excluded — 'should be fast and responsive' has no measurable target to design an approach against; not guessed.
• Reflection: verified ids well-formed, sequential, and in document order; no ungrounded components; gaps correctly reported rather than guessed.
• Knowledge bases consulted: kb-L1-enterprise-architecture — used to classify the 3 components and confirm the REST/database integration patterns.
• Guardrails evaluated: gr-L1-output-schema-validator (pass), gr-L1-pii-detection (pass), gr-L1-consistency-check (pass), gr-L1-hallucination-check (pass).
• Gaps or issues flagged: FR-02 needs a push-provider decision; NFR-01 needs a measurable target.
